# FRWF Presents: RINGFALL: Chaos Circuit
Local-first 3D wrestling game with articulated physics in the original FRWF Arena and Turkey Dome turkey-barn arena. Fresh local setup defaults to Singles; five-wrestler Battle Royale is also available. Explore Showground connects the yard, backstage and ringside with nearby bout offers and device-local saves. Local wrestling uses Three.js and Rapier; showground progression remains device-local.

RINGFALL is an installable browser PWA at https://frwf.ja1.io. Desktop and mobile browsers use their native install flow where available; iPhone and iPad users add it from the browser Share menu, and macOS Safari can add it to the Dock. Its service worker caches the app shell and previously requested same-origin game assets for best-effort offline single-player use. First-use downloads, uncached resources and multiplayer require internet access; offline availability is not guaranteed until a resource has been cached.
Public game: /
Health: /api/health
API docs: /api/docs
OpenAPI: /openapi.yaml
Characters, music, crowd audio and original FRWF background footage load as bundled assets. Local matches need no login. Cloudflare serves the production game and private-room Durable Object at frwf.ja1.io. Private match invitations are single-seat links and do not require a platform key. Online simulation has reduced feature parity and responsive two-client combat remains a separate acceptance check; zero-lag play is not guaranteed. Static discovery does not certify game feel or network quality.

Fighter selection includes 14 playable wrestlers, original user-provided FRWF photographs and live 3D previews. Character bodies and hair are authored offline with MPFB 2.0.17 and converted to the game physics skeleton. Twelve seeded crowd body variants are instanced. These are authored likenesses, not scans; motion capture is not included.

FRWF Underground is a selectable local fight venue using supplied modular brick/steel assets. Its Chaos bouts include chairs, a trash can and a climbable wooden table. Seven showground encounters now include Josh The Enforcer’s underground challenge. Nineteen character signature variants and movement profiles share the local physical combat system; final likeness, motion quality and online parity remain unverified.
